title: Accuracy-levers probe: does expert-forecaster elicitation beat reader-roleplay? (#342)
design: Same fresh disjoint 150-case slice as iter2. Two NEW elicitation modes (single call/case, blinded, order-randomized), contrasted with the prior reader-roleplay null:

modes.comparative: forced choice + brief reasoning: which headline gets higher CTR + confidence -> P(treatment wins)-0.5
modes.popshare: of 100 feed users, how many click A vs B -> clicks_T - clicks_C

scoring: directional_gate G0-G11, delta=0.0, bootstrap=2000 over experiments, 90% CIs, seed=42

hypotheses.H1: does ANY expert-forecaster arm show rank tracking (Kendall tau_b 90% LB > 0 OR balanced SMR Wilson LB > 0.5)?
hypotheses.H2: does expert-forecaster framing beat the prior reader-roleplay null (iter2 sonnet panel rho -0.038)?

decision_rule: If any arm shows robust rank tracking (LB>0) -> elicitation FORMAT was a hidden lever; scale + pre-register confirm. If all null -> format is not the lever on Upworthy; pivot to the supervised avenue (LLM feature-extraction + cross-fit calibration on real CTR).
